inclusion_criteria: Operating public school districts and independent charter LEAs whose geographic boundaries or campus physical locations fall entirely within the 9-county KC metropolitan statistical area
exclusion_criteria: Excludes non-operating LEAs and non-geographic statewide virtual/special service agencies

geographic_scope: Kansas KC Metro (Johnson Leavenworth Miami Wyandotte)
inclusion_criteria: Operating public school districts in the Kansas portion of the 9-county KC metro
exclusion_criteria: Excludes Missouri LEAs and statewide non-geographic agencies
notes: Kansas geographic district denominator for state administrative reconciliation.

geographic_scope: Missouri KC Metro (Cass Clay Jackson Lafayette Platte Ray)
inclusion_criteria: Operating public school districts and independent charter LEAs in the Missouri portion of the 9-county KC metro
exclusion_criteria: Excludes Kansas LEAs and statewide virtual agencies
notes: Missouri geographic district denominator for state administrative reconciliation.

inclusion_criteria: Operating public LEAs fully within region in each respective reporting school year
exclusion_criteria: None within year (allows dynamic entry/exit of charters and consolidations)
notes: Captures contemporary system boundaries in each year (N=78 in 2014-15; N=77 in 2024-25).

inclusion_criteria: Operating public LEAs fully within region continuously present in both SY 2014-15 and SY 2024-25 endpoint files
exclusion_criteria: Excludes LEAs that opened or closed during the 10-year window (e.g. 3 charter LEAs that opened post-2015)
notes: Authoritative 10-year longitudinal balanced panel for growth and capacity trend calculations.

canonical_name: Declining LEAs with Unchanged School Count
inclusion_criteria: LEAs in KC_BALANCED_LEA_75 experiencing negative 10-year enrollment change (enr_24 < enr_14) with zero net change in operating school count (sch_cnt_24 == sch_cnt_14)
exclusion_criteria: Excludes growing LEAs and LEAs with net changes in operating school count
notes: Empirical cohort of declining LEAs with unchanged operating-school counts (132 schools). Evaluates downward staffing stickiness without asserting physical building tracking.

canonical_name: Declining LEAs with Identical School ID Sets
inclusion_criteria: LEAs in KC_DECLINING_UNCHANGED_COUNT_28 whose endpoint active NCESSCH school ID sets are 100% identical between 2014-15 and 2024-25
exclusion_criteria: Excludes 3 LEAs with internal administrative school ID reconfiguration turnover (Adrian R-III Belton 124 Lawson R-XIV)
notes: Stricter institutional continuity sensitivity cohort proving stickiness is not an artifact of administrative school ID turnover. Does not assert physical facility tracking.

canonical_name: Kansas City Regional Regular Operating High Schools (2023-24)
inclusion_criteria: Operating regular secondary schools (school_type == 1 and school_level == High) matched between CRDC 2023-24 and CCD School Universe in regional LEAs
exclusion_criteria: Excludes alternative special education vocational and non-operating secondary schools
notes: Authoritative cross-sectional high school universe (N=109) for CRDC secondary course-size analysis. Specific estimands have support_n <= 109 based on metric validity and reporting (e.g. support_n=101 for Algebra I matched PTR).

canonical_name: Matched Small High School Longitudinal Cohort (<800 Students)
inclusion_criteria: Regular operating high schools present in both 2013-14 and 2023-24 CRDC waves with enrollment < 800 in both waves
exclusion_criteria: Excludes large high schools (>=800 students) and schools that opened or closed between waves
notes: Matched cohort used to test curricular breadth attrition (Calculus and Physics offerings) under small-school enrollment decline.

canonical_name: Jackson County Public Charter LEA Historical Panel
inclusion_criteria: Independent public charter school districts (is_charter == True) physically located in Jackson County MO operating in any school year from 2014-15 through 2024-25
exclusion_criteria: Excludes traditional public school districts (KCPS and suburban districts) and charters outside Jackson County
notes: Longitudinal historical union of 22 charter LEAs (20 active in 2014-15; 20 active in 2024-25). Used for charter-sector capacity and staffing growth analysis.

canonical_name: KCPS Plus Jackson County Charter Sector Combined
inclusion_criteria: Kansas City Public Schools (LEAID 2916400) plus all independent public charter LEAs physically located in Jackson County MO operating in any school year from 2014-15 through 2024-25
exclusion_criteria: Excludes suburban Jackson County traditional public school districts (Independence Raytown Lee's Summit Blue Springs)
notes: Combined public sector panel within the Jackson County urban geography (23 historical LEAs: KCPS + 22 charters; 21 active in 2014-15 and 21 active in 2024-25). Reserved for combined-sector market share comparisons.
